A buyback decision has come in the results batch at both prior August-period prints (2024-10-17, 2025-10-17, plus 2024-04-16) for about +0.8 points of excess, and the April deck's stated trigger is met more strongly than ever at 0.69x NAV and 21% below the last programme's average cost — against LTV already at target and cash committed to MIMARU/Urawa; that is netted by a likely Aug-2027 step-down from 3,150 (the company's own 8/26 slide draws the sale-gain path, so it is mostly priced) and the pre-released Aug-2026 period is worth zero.
